high.title: Gold Ring and Gold Bar Prices Morning 19/5
high.summary: International gold spot prices opened at $4,581/ounce, up 0.3% from previous close after gaining nearly 0.6% on May 18. Gold recovered due to USD weakness (down 0.3% against major currencies basket), making gold cheaper for holders of other currencies. However, upside remains limited by rising bond yields and oil prices amid Iran conflict concerns, increasing inflation fears and expectations of continued monetary tightening. US 10-year Treasury yields continue rising, creating headwinds for non-yielding gold assets. The USD weakening to session lows provided positive support for gold, but experts warn rising bond yields could limit recovery and even pressure prices lower in the short term. This dynamic is crucial for VND/USD traders as USD strength/weakness directly impacts Vietnamese gold import costs and domestic pricing.

high.title: Gold Ring and Gold Bar Prices Morning 20/5
high.summary: Gold prices fell sharply to $4,481/ounce (up just 0.01% from previous close) after declining over 1.8% on May 19. The selloff was driven by stronger USD and prolonged inflation concerns, raising expectations that interest rates will remain elevated longer. US 10-year Treasury yields approached highest levels in over a year, increasing opportunity costs of holding non-yielding gold. Edward Meir from Marex noted gold is under pressure from rising real interest rates across major economies while USD strength creates additional headwinds. Markets are reassessing Fed policy stance amid energy-driven inflation pressures. For VND traders, this USD strength could pressure the Vietnamese dong while rising US yields may influence Vietnamese government bond spreads and capital flow dynamics.

medium.title: VNDirect Chairman Pham Minh Huong: Great Unprecedented Opportunity Opening, VNDirect Preparing "Comeback"
medium.summary: VNDirect's Chairman acknowledged the company had to "slow down" over the past two years due to system attacks and bond market impacts, missing market share opportunities during the recent stock market surge. She noted significant foreign capital outflows over two years but domestic capital remained balanced, though market volatility continues.

medium.title: Gold Company About to IPO - What Does It Have to Challenge PNJ's Monopoly on Stock Exchange?
medium.summary: Bao Tin Manh Hai plans IPO in Q4/2026 and HoSE listing, potentially breaking PNJ's monopoly as the only listed gold company. The company will sell minimum 15% shares with SSI as underwriter, targeting EPS of 25,813 VND/share for 2025.

medium.title: Techcombank Issues Important Notice to Customers
medium.summary: Techcombank warns customers about increasing phone scams using Caller ID spoofing technology and AI voice simulation, displaying names of police, courts, banks or contacts to increase credibility. This reflects ongoing cybersecurity concerns in Vietnam's digital banking sector.

medium.title: One Bank Has Near-Lowest Bad Debt Ratio in System, Lower Than ACB, Techcombank, VietinBank
medium.summary: ABBank achieved 0.82% bad debt ratio, dramatically improving from 3.8% in Q1/2025. System-wide NPLs increased 10.6% to 292.16 trillion VND in Q1/2026. Top 5 lowest NPL ratios: Vietcombank (0.62%), ABBank (0.82%), ACB (0.97%), VietinBank (1.02%), Techcombank (1.09%).

medium.title: One Bank Offers 8.5% Annual Interest for Deposits from 500,000 VND
medium.summary: VietBank launches promotional rates up to 8.5% annually for new savings accounts through May 31, 2026, with 6-11 month terms at 8.3%, 12-14 months at 8.4%, and 15 months at 8.5%, indicating competitive pressure in deposit markets.
